claim_text: The September 17, 2025 indictment in United States v. Aden et al., No. 0:25-cr-00349 (ECF 1) paragraph 23 alleges that from about April 2023 through about May 2025 each of the four defendants personally pocketed between about $300,000 and $400,000 from Brilliant Minds. That is alleged personal pocketing / proceeds from the company, not a Medicaid amount_billed or amount_paid figure. It overlaps the Brilliant Minds ~$2.3 million claims figure. Do not multiply the range by four, do not add it to Falade billed dollars, and do not add it to Feeding Our Future $250 million charging headlines.

supporting_passages.quote: From about April 2023 through about May 2025, each of the defendants personally pocketed between about $300,000 and $400,000 from Brilliant Minds.

amounts.methodology: Lower bound of alleged per-defendant personal pocketing from Brilliant Minds. Not amount_billed. Do not multiply by 4.
Upper bound of alleged per-defendant personal pocketing from Brilliant Minds. Not amount_billed. Do not treat 300000+400000 as 700000 and do not multiply by 4.

qualifiers: per defendant range not a four-person total
do not add to Falade or FOF $250M
editorial_notes: metric_type alleged_loss is used only because the schema has no personal-proceeds token; public wording must say personally pocketed, not stole and not billed.
